title: repair
content_html:
repair

In moments in an unfinished painting, scraping, dissolving and scrubbing leave scars. The title birth of healing forms raises the possibility that a repair can bring something new into being. Hiding a break, joining it visibly and making a new work from what survived each imply a different idea of what needs to be restored. How far can those ideas travel from mending an object to tending to a person? Birth of healing forms · moments in an unfinished painting

Reading note. Daoism. Chapter 79 of the Daodejing allows that ill feeling can persist after a dispute is settled. In moments in an unfinished painting, the marks of earlier interventions remain visible. What has been mended, what has been put back into use, and what persists after the repair? Daodejing, 79
